subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the day of the murder at half past two, with events unfolding through the night and into the next day.
source_quote: A'lai had shown up at the Oak Tree Apothecary at half past two on the day of the murder

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: A polymorph spell lasts an hour

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: Where are the four of you? Who were the rest of you? I didn't see you at the talk.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: there's plenty of time to heal him

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Velkynvelve, which is where this all started: a dwarf in the wrong place, in chains, at the bottom of the world

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Alkrist's safe location
fact: Alkrist's safe is unopened and located in Alkrist's chambers, accessible only through a gap Glabbagool could potentially eat through.
source_quote: open threads: Alkrist's safe, unopened

subject: sapphire and locket relationship
fact: The sapphire is required to find a lost locket; the locket cannot be stolen from a living person holding it.
source_quote: you can't steal a locket off someone who's alive and holding it. You need the sapphire to find a locket that's already lost

subject: monograph authorship
fact: A monograph cannot have multiple authors; a duograph or acknowledged contribution is acceptable.
source_quote: It's a work that has one author

subject: cheese memory
fact: Glabbagool remembers cheese as a real, lost food, and grieves its absence with genuine longing.
source_quote: I remember when there was cheese. Perhaps if we had some cheese.

subject: Glabbagool's evaluation zone
fact: Glabbagool evaluates documents with the same acidic, nutritional focus he applies to food, and has declared non-nutritious material inedible.
source_quote: This is not nutritious. This is not food.

subject: polymorph contradiction
fact: A two-hour gap in sightings contradicts the one-hour duration of a standard polymorph spell, implying a more complex magical mechanism.
source_quote: She'd been seen coming down the stairs between two and three. That's a minimum two-hour gap. A polymorph spell lasts an hour.

subject: Candlekeep monograph archive
fact: Candlekeep values monographs as currency of scholarly influence, with multiple individuals seeking authorship in a single afternoon.
source_quote: Two men after a monograph in one afternoon. That told me something about how this library keeps score.

subject: myth of the person
fact: The dead retain their biases, memories, and performances; magic does not grant objective truth.
source_quote: The myth of the person. The assumption that death is a transparency... They don't. They're still themselves.

subject: terrain as truth
fact: In the Underdark, terrain is the only reliable evidence; magic and testimony are shifting surfaces over fixed facts.
source_quote: In the Underdark, the one thing that didn't lie was terrain.

subject: Oak Tree Apothecary crime scene
fact: The apothecary garden and inner chambers are the site of the poisoning and initial intrusion, with separate theft occurring later.
source_quote: the poison was collected. A mess was made. Alkrist was a dragonborn. Zalthir had caught that this referred to the apothecary intrusion, not whoever had later removed the heart and looted the safe

subject: Grygum's deduction principle
fact: Once the impossible is eliminated, whatever remains — however unlikely — must be the truth.
source_quote: Once you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however unlikely, must be the truth?

subject: Grygum's secretary's office
fact: Glabbagool, the gelatinous cube, serves as secretary and receives all documents, evaluating them for nutritional content.
source_quote: I indicated Glabbagool.

subject: gelatinous cube capability
fact: Glabbagool can eat through walls and safes, but chooses restraint to maintain stealth in investigations.
source_quote: I guess I could have eaten through the safe. It would have taken a while. Walls don't stop us. I can eat through walls.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: third-story apartment discovery
fact: A third-story apartment with an open door in Janussi's chambers remains unvisited.
source_quote: There's something listed as a third-story apartment with an open door we haven't gone into.

subject: wrapping paper trail
fact: The wrapping paper from the poisoned book was taken to Janussi's third-story apartment.
source_quote: the wrapping paper from the poisoned book had been taken there

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch, the First Reader, is the target of a blocked proposal and is now being hunted for his truth-seeking spell.
source_quote: Kalan Strongbranch. The First Reader. The one with the truth-seeking spell that had already anchored the investigation once.

subject: feast burning
fact: Alkrist burned something at the feast, a detail unflagged until Grygum recalled it.
source_quote: there's something in the list about what Alkrist burned at the feast — you should ask about that.

subject: Sylvira's quarters
fact: Sylvira's quarters are a fevered, overheated chamber where she is framed for murder and dying under poison.
source_quote: Sylvira was framed for the murder and dying slowly under the poison's effect.

subject: Sylvira's confession
fact: Sylvira admitted to her final words with Janussi and suspected Kazryn Nyantani of the murder.
source_quote: Those were my last words with him... That bitter old hag... who always resented Janussi for ditching her in favor of me.

subject: Janussi's critique
fact: Janussi's written critique dismissed Kalan Strongbranch's criminal investigation methodology as solipsism.
source_quote: found it to be solipsism, and had blocked it... dismissed as solipsism. Shelved.

subject: Fembris hunts Kalan
fact: Fembris set out to hunt Kalan Strongbranch, the First Reader, to bind the Alkrist interview.
source_quote: I'm gonna have to hunt Kalan down... Let me go, let me go.

subject: Janussi's chambers
fact: Janussi's chambers contain a third-story apartment with hidden evidence, personal writings, and unresolved academic rivalries.
source_quote: Janussi's chambers... The third floor was... well... We kind of heard Janussi had these habits.

subject: Daz interviews Sylvira
fact: Daz conducted a deliberate, empathetic interview with Sylvira, uncovering her framing and motive tied to Menzoberranzan prejudice.
source_quote: I believe I said you were framed... She took it. It was accurate, if not warm.

subject: Grygum uncovers Janussi's note
fact: Grygum discovered and analyzed Janussi’s damning academic note rejecting Kalan’s methodology.
source_quote: I read it... Oh boy, this starts out with some real academic insult.

subject: Alkrist interview preparation
fact: The Alkrist interview is pending, to be bound by Kalan’s truth spell and informed by the feast burning detail.
source_quote: we needed Kalan. And Kalan, apparently, had gone somewhere.

subject: Menzoberranzan thread
fact: The Menzoberranzan thread underlies the framing of Sylvira and the cultural distrust in the investigation.
source_quote: the Menzoberranzan thread running under all of this

subject: three lines of inquiry
fact: Three lines of inquiry—Grygum on physical evidence, Daz on Sylvira, Kalan on truth-binding—are cleanly divided among investigators.
source_quote: Three lines of inquiry. Three investigators. The work divided cleanly, cleaner than most things we attempted.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 11:30 PM of Deadwinter evening, the end-of-year meeting.
source_quote: The end-of-year meeting had been at 11:30 PM

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session, from 12:30 to 1:00 AM.
source_quote: Between 12:30 and 1 in the morning

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: alibi time
fact: She returned to her chambers around 12:30, and saw no one after that.
source_quote: She'd returned to her chambers around 12:30, she thought. After 12:30, she came to her room and saw no one.

subject: gift wrapping
fact: The gift wrap for the deadly book had a clean, deliberate cut, separate from incidental tears, indicating premeditated preparation.
source_quote: A clean cut, straight as a rule, separate from all the ragged tears.

subject: Mordenkainen's Mansion
fact: Her son lives in a Mordenkainen's Mansion she constructed specifically for his protection.
source_quote: born in the Abyss, living in a Mordenkainen's Mansion she'd constructed specifically for his protection.

subject: midnight tears
fact: The poison 'midnight tears' was applied to the book, bookmarked in 1001 Tashalian Nights, and the vial's label was torn off and tied to the Dead Winter tree.
source_quote: The book was bookmarked at the midnight tears part... the vial's label torn off and tied to the back of the Dead Winter tree.

subject: avowed count
fact: Members of the avowed who had long nurtured hostility toward her are the ones who would falsely claim to have seen her after 12:30.
source_quote: it would be members of the avowed who had long nurtured hostility toward her.

subject: Bookwyrm's confrontation
fact: Bookwyrm argued with Alkrist after learning of the poisoning, stormed off, and later acted to conceal the crime by removing Janussi's heart.
source_quote: She had been appalled... and then she was gone... That was Bookwyrm.

subject: Oak Tree Apothecary
fact: The stolen vial of midnight tears was obtained from the Oak Tree Apothecary, where peppermint was spilled on the counter floor.
source_quote: The Oak Tree Apothecary, the stolen vial, peppermint spilled on the counter floor.

subject: meeting time
fact: The baths meeting occurred at 11:45 PM between A'lai and Alkrist.
source_quote: Eleven forty-five. A'lai and Alkrist, discussing what needed to be done about their mutual problem.

subject: chalice
fact: The chalice was used to hide something that only someone with specific knowledge would suspect — not Alkrist.
source_quote: Someone had known about the chalice: what it was for, what could be hidden inside it, why no one would think to look there without specific reason.

subject: truth spell
fact: Kalan's truth spell was active during Alkrist's interrogation, rendering his statements compelled and verifiable.
source_quote: Kalan was outside the door. As of right now, Alkrist could not lie.

subject: Janussi's third-floor rooms
fact: A crumpled piece of gift wrap was retrieved from the dining hall trash, not from Janussi's rooms, indicating deliberate disposal to avoid detection.
source_quote: Wrapping paper. Nothing written on it that meant anything... came out of the dining hall trash

subject: 1001 Tashalian Nights
fact: The book 1001 Tashalian Nights was bookmarked at the 'midnight tears' passage, indicating prior study and intent.
source_quote: The book was on a shelf, bookmarked... Midnight tears. Tidy, annotated, marked

subject: hand-washing
fact: Alkrist washed his hands in a basin of water after burning the vial's label, attempting to remove traces of midnight tears.
source_quote: He had washed his hands in it, just in case there was any midnight tears on them.

subject: Bookwyrm's chambers
fact: Bookwyrm received two bottles of fine wine from Alkrist and argued with him before storming off, later acting to cover up the murder.
source_quote: Two bottles of the finest wine, two glasses, and the announcement that all their problems... had been solved.

subject: motive
fact: Teles Ahvoste's motive was jealousy — passed over for Keeper of Tomes despite being older and more skilled than Janussi, a grudge sustained for nearly twenty years.
source_quote: Teles had remained hostile toward Janussi for nearly twenty years, passed over for Keeper of Tomes despite being older than Janussi and generally considered the more skilled practitioner.

subject: Abyss
fact: Her son was born in the Abyss and carries an abyssal plague that infected her after their last argument.
source_quote: born in the Abyss, which has consequences

subject: reused wrapping paper
fact: The gift wrap was possibly reused, but the clean cut suggests it was cut from a larger sheet and deliberately resealed to conceal the book's contents.
source_quote: Could be someone who reuses wrapping paper... but there was something else. A straight edge where there shouldn't be one.

subject: midnight tears vial
fact: The vial of midnight tears had its label torn off and used as a decoration on the Dead Winter tree, to misdirect investigation.
source_quote: the vial's label torn off and tied to the back of the Dead Winter tree as decoration

subject: mind control claim
fact: Alkrist falsely claimed he was under mind control to invalidate his compelled testimony, revealing desperation and guilt.
source_quote: I am under mind control, and everything I have said is so true.

subject: dining hall trash
fact: The gift wrap was discarded in the dining hall trash, not Janussi's rooms, to avoid direct association with the crime scene.
source_quote: came out of the dining hall trash, which meant someone had opened a gift in there, or carried the wrapping there to discard it

subject: polymorph suspicion
fact: It is suspected that Bookwyrm used a powerful polymorph spell to transform Janussi's heart after removing it, concealing the true cause of death.
source_quote: Does he think Bookwyrm knows a powerful polymorph spell?

subject: Mending cantrip
fact: The Mending cantrip was used to restore the torn gift wrap, revealing the deliberate cut that proved premeditation.
source_quote: Mending is smart... The paper did the rest. The torn pieces came together under my hands.

subject: alibi verification
fact: Her claim of being with her son after 12:30 is verifiable as an alibi, since she saw no one after returning to her chambers.
source_quote: After 12:30, she came to her room and saw no one.

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the day careers were made or broken.
source_quote: Budget day. Review day. The day careers were made or broken.

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: By midnight he was dead.

subject: chasme count
fact: Three people are involved, at least.
source_quote: Yeah. There's 3 people involved, at least.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Alkrist count
fact: Alkrist and A'lai are separately implicated.
source_quote: Janussi had managed to hand Bookwyrm, Alkrist, and A'lai, separately

subject: Candlekeep access level
fact: Anyone with sufficient standing can access what they needed.
source_quote: Anyone here with sufficient standing could access what they needed.

subject: blackmail negotiation
fact: Blackmail may be a way to get information that's very hard to come by.
source_quote: Blackmail may be a way to get it.

subject: book per suspect
fact: One book per suspect is the proposed collection metric.
source_quote: I'm gonna insist that we get a book per suspect.

subject: Menzoberranzan connection
fact: A'lai has Underdark connections, possibly Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: A'lai, moreover, is a drow. He might have information that Daz needs.

subject: workforce restructuring
fact: The assassination is framed as workforce restructuring.
source_quote: File the assassination under *workforce restructuring*.

subject: patron entry value
fact: The only price of interest is what A'lai knows about the patron paying Menzoberranzan rates.
source_quote: That is the only price I am interested in collecting.
